t: You're looking at a gorilla statue in East Village, the neighbourhood built in Stratford for the 2012 Olympic Games. It was made by the artist John Cox, who lived from 1952 to 2014. Cox is the person credited with making this piece, so what you see is his work, standing here in the street. I don't have more detail about when it was made or what inspired it, so take a moment to look at it up close: the pose, the surface, and how it sits among the buildings around it.
